derivedFrom.sequencingNote: Per the Batch 3 approval packet's sequencing authority, Batch 3 here is the non-term hardware/accessory child-line scope: the default-selected wireless mounting/bracket/single-pack accessories under CW9178I-CFG, and the default-selected and bundled zero-price non-term hardware accessories under the C9300X-48HX-A and C9300L-24P-4X-A switches (SSD placeholders, stacking/power cables, uplink network module, rack rubber feet/screws/cable guides, fan modules, and the stacking kit/module/cable). This intentionally differs from the older HONEYWELL_RULE_APPROVAL_BATCH_STRATEGY.md labeling of Batch 3 as replacement candidates; that strategy doc is unchanged, and replacement candidates plus optics remain deferred and out of scope.
derivedFrom.note: Authored as a NEW artifact from the explicit human/business Batch 3 approval. The source candidate packs and the review/approval packet files are unchanged and remain candidate/pending; the approved Batch 1 and Batch 2 packs are unchanged. No candidate, review, or prior approved pack status was flipped or mutated to author this approved pack.

approval.decision: I approve Batch 3 for Honeywell MVP: approve questions 1-6, including FAN-T2 x3 and C9300L-STACK-A x2 quantity multipliers, and confirm questions 7-8 remain deferred/out of scope. This is Honeywell MVP only, not broad Cisco-general approval, and it does not approve optics, replacement candidates, pricing authority, or silent SKU substitution.
approvedDecisions: Wireless non-term accessories under CW9178I-CFG (AIR-AP-BRACKET-2, AIR-AP-T-RAIL-F, CW9178-SINGLE) as advisory engineer-review options.
C9300X-48HX-A bundled zero-price rack hardware (C9K-ACC-RBFT, C9K-ACC-SCR-4, CAB-GUIDE-1RU).
C9300X-48HX-A default-selected hardware options (C9300-SSD-NONE, STACK-T1-50CM, CAB-SPWR-30CM, C9300X-NM-8Y) as advisory engineer-review options.
C9300L-24P-4X-A bundled zero-price rack/stacking hardware (FAN-T2 at 3 per parent, C9K-ACC-RBFT, C9K-ACC-SCR-4, CAB-GUIDE-1RU, C9300L-STACK-A at 2 per parent, STACK-T3A-50CM).
C9300L-24P-4X-A default-selected hardware options (C9300L-SSD-NONE, C9300L-STACK-KIT2) as advisory engineer-review options.
FAN-T2 fixed_per_parent x3 and C9300L-STACK-A fixed_per_parent x2 quantity multipliers confirmed at engineer review.
caveats: This is not broad Cisco-general approval.
Default-selected lines are advisory engineer-review options, not silently forced universal Cisco defaults.
Optics remain deferred and are not approved.
Replacement candidates remain deferred and are not approved.
No silent SKU substitution is approved.
Questions 7-8 remain deferred / out of scope.
Batch 1 and Batch 2 are separate approved packs and are unchanged.

notes: PARTIAL approved runtime rule pack: only the Honeywell MVP Batch 3 non-term hardware/accessory configuration-expansion decisions are active. This is not broad Cisco-general approval and does not approve all 53 candidate child lines. Batch 1 (deterministic model-safety lines) and Batch 2 (term/support/software lines) are SEPARATE approved packs (honeywell-batch1-approved-rules, honeywell-batch2-approved-rules) and are unchanged by this pack. Optics remain deferred; replacement candidates remain deferred; no silent SKU substitution is approved. Default-selected lines are advisory engineer-review options, not silently forced universal Cisco defaults. No pricing authority is encoded here; what to add/default/offer is configuration authority, while pricing is resolved separately from the catalog/price source at runtime, so the two stay strictly separate. The source candidate packs (honeywell-candidate-rules.json, honeywell-candidate-rules-v2.json) and the review/approval packet files (including honeywell-batch3-approval-packet.json) remain unchanged and candidate/pending; this approved pack is a new, separate artifact.
